currentRoundInspection.scope: Xystus north conservation rooms and related oval court remains only. Mapped north rectangle provides exact roof scale; ordinary aerial proportions guide a reconstructed open oval boundary, selected low stone wall remains and24 short column/base remains. The north shelter has pale infill/stone base, grey metal gabled roof, timber support trim and a real south door recess/soffit/threshold. No roof or floor fills the outdoor court: original terrain remains between individual occupied low walls and pads. Main villa/baths, Triclinium, gate piers and two latrines remain independent. No copied mosaics, furnished rooms or invented intact ancient colonnade.
